name: Cauliflower Pepper Soup
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion and garlic for 4 minutes.
Add the cauliflower, beans, stock, bay leaf and pepper.
Simmer covered for 15 minutes until the cauliflower is very soft. Remove the bay leaf.
Blend until smooth, then stir in the soy milk.
Reheat gently and season with salt and extra pepper.
note: Peppery and creamy with only about 4 g of fat per bowl.
